messages:
maya: Heads-up: planning to enable rdx-13b-fp16 in the model catalog tomorrow 2025-06-01 03:00 UTC. Need preflight signoff on fallback ordering, dedicated pin list, rollback thresholds. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/rdx-13b-fp16

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout queued by @maya for 2025-06-01T03:00Z. Runbook: /docs/releases/rdx-13b-fp16-cutover

andre: What's the initial canary split?
maya: 10% for first 30m (us-west), then 50% 2h, then 100% if metrics OK.

li: Which dedicated pools to pin? need list for cluster-ops
maya: pin dedicated: cluster-dedicated-ai-1
emma: perf eval: latency +12% p95, token-cost -22% on chat-loadset. quality regressions: none on core prompts.

nora: proposing rollback triggers: error-rate increase >1 percentage point absolute OR p95 latency >2x baseline for 10m. auto-rollback after sustained 10m.

andre: fallback ordering proposal:
```json
{
  "fallback_order": ["rdx-7b-q4", "rdx-13b-fp16", "rdx-30b-q8"],
  "pin_list": {"dedicated": ["cluster-dedicated-ai-1"], "private": []},
  "canary": {"percent": 10, "window_mins": 30},
  "rollback": {"error_rate_abs_pp": 1, "p95_factor": 2, "sustained_mins": 10}
}
```

li: LGTM for pin and fallback ordering. cluster-ops acked reserved capacity.

nora: Change window confirmed: 03:00-06:00 UTC. I'll be on-call and manually monitor metrics and chat ops during canary.

maya: tagging SRE and Platform: @andre @li please watch deploybot alerts, set temporary alert tweaks to avoid noisy alerts for token-cost blips.

deploy-bot: rollout started: canary 10% -> target=rdx-13b-fp16 @ 2025-06-01T03:00:10Z

andre: Seeing initial warmup spike in p95, ~1.6x baseline, watching.

emma: that's expected during KV cache warmup for new kernels, should settle within 6-8 minutes.

andre: p95 back down to 1.1x after 7m, error-rate unchanged.

nora: moving to 50% after 30m if no regressions. scheduled at 03:30 UTC.

li: cluster-dedicated-ai-1 pinned and traffic routed.

maya: Release note snippet for public changelog:
```text
rdx-13b-fp16: new fp16 variant with improved cost/throughput tradeoff. Default fallback order updated to prefer rdx-7b-q4 for short queries. See internal perf notes.
```

andre: +1
li: :thumbsup:
emma: :rocket:

nora: Cutover complete at 04:45 UTC, 100% traffic. No rollback triggers hit. Post-rollout follow-ups: monitor SLA for next 24h and report in #eng-sre.

maya: Thanks team — I'll publish release notes and close the ticket.
